text: 🎬 Sally Field wins the Emmy. At 79. Every bit earned. Sally Field took home Outstanding Lead Actress for Netflix's Remarkably Bright Creatures , becoming the oldest winner in her category. It looks like cozy background streaming. It isn't. Director Olivia Newman built something genuinely warm and well-crafted, and Field carries it with a precision that makes you forget she's acting at all. Two Oscars and a near-mythic ability to make good material feel true. Netflix handed her a solid script, and she handed Netflix a masterclass. ✈️ Add to watchlist

🍿 Mr. Irrelevant: the last pick who made it count 📆 Estreno: December 25, 2026 🎭 Género: #Drama #Sports #Biopic ✈️ Add to watchlist David Corenswet carries this thing on pure screen presence. Classic jaw, Golden Age magnetism, the kind of face Paramount used to build careers around. Good fit for a story that needs you to believe in a guy nobody believed in. John Tuggle was the very last pick of the 1983 NFL Draft. Dead at 25 from cancer. That is not a feel-good arc; it is a gut punch with a jersey on. Michael Shannon in the supporting cast suggests Paramount isn't playing it safe. The real question is whether the film earns the tragedy or soft-pedals it into sports-movie wallpaper. The trailer hints at both. Cautiously on board.
